title: Hunyuan Probe Health Response v1
description: JSON body returned by a Hunyuan shape-provider HTTP endpoint at GET /health, parsed by lathe/capabilities.py::probe_hunyuan_endpoint. Trust boundary: response is network-sourced. additionalProperties:true lets endpoint implementations attach diagnostic fields; unknown keys are warned but not rejected so probe doesn't break on upstream field additions.

status.description: Free-form status label reported by the endpoint (e.g. 'ok', 'ready', 'degraded').

version.description: Version string advertised by the service.

raw.description: Present only when the response body was not a JSON object (populated by the probe, not the server).
